premises: Deep cryogenic treatment (DCT) can reduce residual stresses in additively manufactured high-entropy alloys.
DCT can heal microstructural defects such as micro-porosities in additively manufactured high-entropy alloys.
DCT can induce beneficial microstructural reorganization (e.g., nano-twinning, dislocation rearrangement) in high-entropy alloys.
A gradual rewarming schedule after DCT prevents thermal shock and microcracking in high-entropy alloys.
